# Ketsuin (結印)

> Ninja Hand Sign Input Method — type with your hands using AI-powered webcam detection.

## Overview

Ketsuin is a free, open-source web application that lets you type text using 12 ninja hand signs (based on the zodiac seals from Japanese ninja tradition). It uses a YOLOX-Nano object detection model running in the browser via ONNX Runtime WebAssembly to recognize hand signs from your webcam feed, then maps them through a T9 predictive text engine to produce characters.

## Key Features

- Real-time hand sign detection via webcam (YOLOX-Nano, ONNX Runtime WASM)
- T9 predictive text input mapped to 12 ninja seals
- Challenge mode: compete on jutsu sequences against global leaderboard
- 9 jutsu challenges from Chidori (4 seals) to Water Dragon (44 seals)
- Ninja ranking system: Genin through Six Paths
- Three languages: English, Chinese (中文), Japanese (日本語)
- Works entirely in-browser, no server-side processing for detection

## Technical Stack

- React 19, TypeScript, Vite 7, Tailwind CSS v4
- ONNX Runtime Web (WASM) for ML inference
- YOLOX-Nano model for hand sign detection
- Supabase for leaderboard data
- Hosted on Vercel
